title: 6-shogaol against 3-Nitropropionic acid-induced Huntington's disease in rodents: Based on molecular docking/targeting pro-inflammatory cytokines/NF-kappaB-BDNF-Nrf2 pathway.
authors: Jambi, Ebtihaj J; Alamri, Abdulaziz; Afzal, Muhammad; Al-Abbasi, Fahad A; Al-Qahtani, Salwa D; Almalki, Naif A R; Bawadood, Azizah Salim; Alzarea, Sami I; Sayyed, Nadeem; Kazmi, Imran
one_liner_zh: 该文研究6-shogaol对3-NPA诱导亨廷顿病大鼠的神经保护作用，仅用分子对接评估小分子与炎症/神经营养蛋白的结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Huntington's disease (HD) is an extremely harmful autosomal inherited neurodegenerative disease. Motor dysfunction, mental disorder, and cognitive deficits are the characteristic features of this disease. The current study examined whether 6-shogaol has a protective effect against 3-Nitropropionic Acid (3-NPA)-induced HD in rats. METHODS: A total of thirty male Wistar rats received 6-shogaol (10 and 20 mg/kg, per oral) an hour before injection of 3-NPA (10 mg/kg i.p.) for 15 days. Behavioral tests were performed, including narrow beam walk, rotarod test, and grip strength test. Biochemical tests promoting oxidative stress were evaluated [superoxide dismutase (SOD), reduced glutathione (GSH), catalase (CAT) and malondialdehyde (MDA)], including changes to neurotransmitters serotonin (5-HT), dopamine (DA), norepinephrine (NE), homovanillic acid (HVA), (3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetic acid (DOPAC), gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), and 5-hydroxy indole acetic acid (5-HIAA), nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukins-1beta (IL-1beta), IL-6, brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2). The 6-shogaol was docked to the active site of TNF-alpha (2AZ5), NF-kappaB (1SVC), BDNF) [1B8M], and Nrf2 [5FZN] proteins using AutoDock tools. RESULTS: The 6-shogaol group significantly improved behavioral activity over the 3-NPA-injected control rats. Moreover, 3-NPA-induced significantly altered neurotransmitters, biochemical and neuroinflammatory indices, which could efficiently be reversed by 6-shogaol. The 6-shogaol showed favorable negative binding energies at -9.271 (BDNF) kcal/mol. CONCLUSIONS: The present investigation demonstrated the neuroprotective effects of 6-shogaol in an experimental animal paradigm against 3-NPA-induced HD in rats. The suggested mechanism is supported by immunohistochemical analysis and western blots, although more research is necessary for definite confirmation.
abstract_zh: 背景：亨廷顿病（Huntington's disease, HD）是一种极具危害性的常染色体遗传性神经退行性疾病。运动功能障碍、精神障碍和认知缺陷是该疾病的特征性表现。本研究探讨了6-姜烯酚（6-shogaol）对大鼠3-硝基丙酸（3-Nitropropionic Acid, 3-NPA）诱导的HD是否具有保护作用。方法：共三十只雄性Wistar大鼠在注射3-NPA（10 mg/kg，腹腔注射）前一小时接受6-姜烯酚（10和20 mg/kg，口服）治疗，持续15天。进行了行为学测试，包括窄梁行走、旋转杆测试和握力测试。评估了促进氧化应激的生化指标[超氧化物歧化酶（superoxide dismutase, SOD）、还原型谷胱甘肽（reduced glutathione, GSH）、过氧化氢酶（catalase, CAT）和丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）]，以及神经递质[血清素（serotonin, 5-HT）、多巴胺（dopamine, DA）、去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine, NE）、高香草酸（homovanillic acid, HVA）、3,4-二羟基苯乙酸（3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetic acid, DOPAC）、γ-氨基丁酸（gamma-aminobutyric acid, GABA）和5-羟基吲哚乙酸（5-hydroxy indole acetic acid, 5-HIAA）]、核因子kappa-B（nuclear factor kappa-B, NF-kappaB）、肿瘤坏死因子-alpha（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）、白细胞介素-1beta（interleukins-1beta, IL-1beta）、IL-6、脑源性神经营养因子（brain-derived neurotrophic factor, BDNF）和核因子E2相关因子2（nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2, Nrf2）的变化。使用AutoDock工具将6-姜烯酚对接至TNF-alpha（2AZ5）、NF-kappaB（1SVC）、BDNF（1B8M）和Nrf2（5FZN）蛋白的活性位点。结果：6-姜烯酚组显著改善了3-NPA注射对照组大鼠的行为活动。此外，3-NPA诱导的神经递质、生化和神经炎症指标显著改变，这些改变可被6-姜烯酚有效逆转。6-姜烯酚显示出有利的负结合能，为-9.271（BDNF）kcal/mol。结论：本研究证明了6-姜烯酚在实验动物模型中对3-NPA诱导的大鼠HD具有神经保护作用。免疫组织化学分析和蛋白质印迹支持了所提出的机制，但仍需更多研究进行确切确认。
